QuestInfo.name: There's a Hole in the Nautilus
QuestInfo.0: Bonnie found a hole in the bottom of the Nautilus, and she might sink! And just when you were getting used to this whole Pirate thing, too! Help Bonnie patch it up.
QuestInfo.1: Bonnie needs Glue to fix the hole, and Bartol's the only guy who can make it. Get some Glue from Bartol before Bonnie gets too tired to hold the water back!
QuestInfo.2: You and Bonnie saved the Nautilus from sinking!

0.0: My fingers are at their limit... If I move my hands, the ship will sink... Someone, please help me...

yes.0: Oh, thank you, thank you! Please... I need Glue. I'll find something to plug the hole with, but I need Glue to make it stick. Hurry...I can't feel my fingers anymore. What if...a fish ate them?
yes.1: Only #r#p1092011##k can make #b#t04033013##k. Go see Bartol and get Glue from him.

no.0: This isn't funny... We're really gonna sink...

1.0: Wha-at?! A hole in our ship? Why didn't you come sooner?

yes.0: Okay, so...I know how to make #b#t04033013##k, but I ran out of both #b#t04033013##k and the materials to make it. Oh, why did I pick today to make my popsicle-stick palace?

npc.0: My hands are the only thing keeping this ship aloat! Go to Bartol and get that Glue!
